scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=birari-unisex-salon/prisma/schema.prisma && cd birari-unisex-salon && node prisma/seed.js && ../node_modules/.bin/next build && rm -rf ../.next && cp -R .next ../.next
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='node_modules/styled-jsx'; const dst='node_modules/next/node_modules/styled-jsx'; if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.mkdirSync('node_modules/next/node_modules',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});}"
